goals.title: Drop the unused CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT env var
goals.description:
dot_claude/settings.json:4 sets "CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT": "1" alongside CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS and CLAUDE_CODE_SCROLL_SPEED.
Forked subagents are no longer gated behind that flag, so the entry is dead config that survives into every session.
Remove it, confirm no rule, script, or E2E check in .github/e2e/verify.sh asserts on it, and re-run chezmoi apply to land the change in $HOME.

goals.title: Switch pi-subagents to the nicobailon fork
goals.description:
Replace the published npm:@tintinweb/pi-subagents package with https://github.com/nicobailon/pi-subagents in the pi extension list.
Touch points: dot_pi/agent/settings.json:26 (the packages array), .github/e2e/verify.sh:189 and :219 (the jq assertion and the install line), README.md:326 and :334, and .claude/rules/agents/pi.md:38 and :41, which both name the tintinweb package by hand.
Confirm what package spec pi accepts for a git source before editing, since the settings entry is a package string and not a URL field.
Re-check the managed Explore and Plan definitions in dot_pi/agent/agents/ against the fork built-ins, because pi.md flags those as hand-maintained restatements of upstream defaults that do not track package updates.

goals.title: Remove Claude LSP's
goals.description:
I want to audit the Claude LSPs. I'm not sure if they're contributing or hurting my context. You can run an audit. Let me know what you think.

Audit result (2026-08-11): keeping all five LSP plugins. They are not a context cost. Each plugin ships only a README and LICENSE; the whole payload is one lspServers block in the marketplace catalog, with no skills, agents, commands, hooks, or MCP servers. Total context is one LSP tool (~400 tokens of schema, deferred in current builds), and zero LSP diagnostics are injected: 0 hits across all 556 transcripts. They are also not contributing: the LSP tool has been called 23 times ever, all 23 in the single session that explicitly tested them. The real costs are RAM (~1.03 GB resident per session in this repo alone: tsserver 523 MB + 144 MB, typescript-language-server 72 MB, pyright 290 MB, spawned eagerly and never queried), 432 MB of disk, and ~516 lines of repo infrastructure across 18 files. Decision was to accept those and keep the current set.
